svg.title: The witness remembers
svg.desc: A tiles-first log restored from a backup. The witness cosigns checkpoints 62, 222, 312 and 595. After the restore the log publishes 322 and 593: older than what the witness cosigned, refused. Then 817, 954, 1032 and 1311: larger, but no consistency proof from 595 can exist, because the history differs. All refused. The log is dead to every client that requires this witness.

text.tspan: Part 05's witness turns a silent fork into a log that nobody can use: the failure is loud.
